Ukrainian drones hit 9 of Russia's 35 biggest refineries in a single week, the Defense Ministry says. Oil processing has fallen by roughly 30% to 200,000 tonnes a day.

The ministry adds that a quick fix is not possible, since some units could take 6 to 8 months to restore, and h
Zelensky says in his address that Russians pick one region as a special target and spend several days hammering it, going after everything including the grids and substations.

NATO is dropping the 2027 leaders' summit in Albania and cutting the number of top-level meetings overall. Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama says no new date is set, it definitely won't happen in 2027, and if it goes ahead in 2028 Tirana will host it.
